name: Ohime-sama wa, Panthera Leo
original_name: お姫様は、ぱんてられお
source:
Mamoru is a university undergrad who, being a hikikomori, doesn’t go to school unless absolutely necessary. One day in May, he was lectured by a prof due to his lousy attendance. He went to the roof for a breath of fresh air and while he was sitting on the bench and looking at the sky… a hole opened up in the sky! Out comes a lion princess, followed soon after by her brother and sister.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/02/03/february-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
守是一名大学生，却因长期闭门不出，除非万不得已几乎从不去学校。五月的一天，他因为出勤情况太差而被教授训了一顿。之后，他来到屋顶透气，正坐在长椅上望着天空时…天空竟裂开了一个洞！一位狮子公主从中现身，紧随其后的还有她的哥哥和妹妹。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/02/03/february-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
